disclaimer: Not a diagnosis — discuss health questions with a healthcare provider.
target_interpretation: Binary survey-derived menstrual-status proxy; not a diagnosis or a four-stage reproductive life-stage model.

label_rule.known_conditions_excluded_from_both_clas: RHD280 == 1 OR RHQ305 == 1 OR RHD143 == 1 OR RHQ200 == 1
label_rule.missing_condition_fields: Not interpreted as yes; some missingness is structural because of public-file disclosure restrictions.

estradiol_policy: Required non-missing for cohort consistency and retained for audit, but prohibited as a classification feature.
